When Effort Has Taken You as Far as It Can

Private mentorship for women who have reached the limits of effort, control, and self-reliance.

You may have spent years doing what you know how to do well. Thinking ahead. Taking care of what needs to be handled. Holding everything together.

It has taken you far.

And something may be asking for a different response now.

This work is for the woman ready to see the patterns shaping her life, and what may be possible beyond them.

Explore Private Mentorship
When the Old Ways Stop Working

Nothing has to be falling apart.

Your life may work very well from the outside. You may be accomplished, capable, deeply responsible, and accustomed to finding your own way through difficult things.

And still, something may no longer be responding to effort.

You may understand a pattern intellectually and still repeat it when it matters most. Over-functioning. Anticipating what others need. Trying to control the outcome. Taking responsibility for more than is yours.

Over decades of working with women, I began to see the same strategies appearing across very different parts of a life.

The independence that helped you succeed may make it difficult to receive support. The ability to manage everything may eventually become the thing that keeps you from knowing what you actually want.

What once served you can begin to limit you. That is where this work begins.

Private Mentorship

I work privately with a small number of women over six to nine months.

We begin with what is present.

A relationship at a threshold. A decision you cannot seem to make. A pattern you understand but cannot quite change. A part of your life that no longer feels true.

From there, we follow what is actually happening.

The work is not built around a curriculum. It is built around you.

Learn About Private Mentorship
What the Work Makes Room For

The aim is not to become a better version of yourself.

It is to see what has been in the way of who you already are.

As those layers become clearer, there is more room for choice.

Less managing. Less anticipating. Less effort spent trying to hold everything in place.

More clarity about what you want, what is yours, and what no longer is.

About Dr. Angela Le

Decades of clinical practice with women.

Dr. Angela Le is a Doctor of Acupuncture and Chinese Medicine whose work has evolved over decades of clinical practice with women.

She is the founder of Fifth Avenue Fertility Wellness in New York City.

Her private mentorship grew from something she witnessed repeatedly in clinical practice: the concern that brings a woman in is often only part of the story.

Angela has an unusual ability to see what may be difficult to see from inside your own life, and to help you uncover what has been there all along.

When You Listen to What Is Alive in You

There is often a moment before change when nothing on the outside has happened yet. You simply know.

Something you have been tolerating becomes harder to ignore. A question becomes more honest. You begin to see what you have been managing, and what you actually want.

You do not need to know where that recognition will lead. You can begin there.
